film.use: mask: tint grey-brown; draw tiled over the lower band and rear faces, alpha by the grime amount and the height fall-off

dust.use: mask: pale; on the PALETTE canvas (destination-out lightens) or tint very light; the base canvas can only darken

speckle.use: mask: tint the dirt colour; origin is the wheel, the fan opens up; rotate so up points along the spray; scale 60 to 100 texels

cakes.use: rgb = shade (multiply with the mud colour), alpha = outline; index i: x = (i%4)*128, y = floor(i/4)*128; draw wet when the mud is fresh, cross-fade to the dry cell as it dries; 8 to 14 texels

streaks.use: mask: tint the dirt colour; down is +y; on vertical panels, alpha by the rain-streaked share; 80 to 200 texels long
